notes.title: Brotherhood United [Update 1.1]
notes.notes:
Some of you may have experienced some problems to got all the 3 Stars on two or three levels. We took time to correct that, and we improved in the same time the ennemi and bro counter. 

Now each area has it's own ennemi and bro to rescue counter. That allows the player to know better what is exactly missing to complete one area. 

We also added a "missed" counter for the ennemies and bro's that you forget in the level. When you get a miss somewhere it means that in the previous areas you forgot to save your friends or that you left some enemies alive. 

We really hope that these improvements will help you to complete Brotherhood United at 100%. And we deeply apologize for the inconvenience that this bug may have caused to some people. 

Have fun and if you have some questions don't hesitate ! ;)
